jei.golemgarage.garage_repair.note: Paid from your inventory, the golem, or a chest next to the controller
jei.golemgarage.info.blueprint: Use it on a golem to record its build and rules. Use it on another golem to rebuild that build from parts in your inventory.
jei.golemgarage.info.cub: A small golem friend. Dye it, dress it in outfits (right-click it with one, or open its wardrobe with an empty hand), and feed it three golem parts for different slots to grow it into a full golem.
jei.golemgarage.info.dock: A golem's home. Link a golem to it with the Golem Linker in Home mode and give it a "rest at its dock" rule: on the dock it slowly recharges and heals, and the pad lights up.
jei.golemgarage.info.garage: Build a sealed room 3 to 9 blocks wide and deep and 4 to 8 tall, with 2 to 4 Laser Emitters in the ceiling and the Garage Controller in a wall. Hold the controller to see a building plan. Right-click the controller with a broken golem to repair it. Add Garage Doors and Windows (or any glass) to the walls so golems can drive in and you can watch.
jei.golemgarage.info.golem: Place it, then right-click it with parts to build it up: a head, torso, arms, legs and a core. Right-click it with an empty hand to open its panel, where you can give it rules. Press G while looking at it (or sneak + right-click with an empty hand) to pick it up again.
jei.golemgarage.info.linker: Shift + right-click the air to pick a mode, right-click a block to mark it, then right-click a golem to link it: a post, chest A, chest B, a Garage, two corners of a work area, or a Golem Dock home. In Group mode, shift + scroll picks a group and right-clicking a golem adds it. Hold it to see every golem's links.
jei.golemgarage.info.manual: The Golem Engineer's Manual explains everything in Golem Garage. You get one the first time you join a world, and you can craft more from a book and an iron ingot.
jei.golemgarage.info.module: Right-click a golem with a module to install it. A golem has 2 module sockets; take one out again from the Status tab of its panel.
jei.golemgarage.info.module_casing: The empty shell every upgrade module is built in.
jei.golemgarage.info.outfit: Clothes for cubs. Right-click a cub to put it on, or open the cub's wardrobe. Wear three pieces of the same style (cool, goth, cute, fancy, spooky, winter or summer) for a matching set.
jei.golemgarage.info.part: Right-click a golem with a part to fit it. The material decides its strength and traits. Repair a worn part on an anvil with its material, with a Repair Kit, or in a Garage.
jei.golemgarage.info.repair_kit: Right-click a golem with it (or let the golem use one with the "repair itself" rule) to restore a quarter of every part's durability.
jei.golemgarage.info.signal_plate: A golem using the "send a redstone signal" rule while standing on this plate powers it.
jei.golemgarage.info.steel_ingot: A strong material for golem parts. Craft two iron ingots with a piece of coal to make it. Steel from other mods works too.
rule.golemgarage.do.deposit_to_nearest: put items in the nearest chest
rule.golemgarage.do.give_to_golem: give its items to a nearby golem
rule.golemgarage.do_help.attack_hostile: Fights the nearest monster it can see.
rule.golemgarage.do_help.deposit_to_b: Puts its items into linked chest B.
rule.golemgarage.do_help.deposit_to_near: Puts its items into the nearest chest or barrel within 8 blocks.
rule.golemgarage.do_help.emit_signal: Powers a Golem Signal Plate it's standing on.
rule.golemgarage.do_help.give_to_golem: Walks to the nearest of your golems with room (within 12 blocks) and hands over its items. Good for a harvester feeding a hauler.
rule.golemgarage.do_help.go_home: Walks onto its Golem Dock (linked with the Linker in Home mode) and rests there, slowly recharging and healing.
rule.golemgarage.do_help.go_to_garage: Walks into its linked Garage for a full repair.
rule.golemgarage.do_help.go_to_post: Walks to its post (set with the Golem Linker) and stays there.
rule.golemgarage.do_help.harvest_crops: Harvests ripe crops and replants them. Needs Scythe Arms or Grabber Claws.
rule.golemgarage.do_help.patrol: Walks between random spots inside its work area. Mark two corners with the Golem Linker.
rule.golemgarage.do_help.pick_up_items: Collects dropped items nearby (further with Grabber Claws).
rule.golemgarage.do_help.recharge: Walks to a placed redstone block within 12 blocks and charges.
rule.golemgarage.do_help.repair_self: Uses a Repair Kit from its own inventory.
rule.golemgarage.do_help.stroll: Wanders around its post, or where it is.
rule.golemgarage.do_help.take_from_a: Takes a stack at a time from linked chest A.
rule.golemgarage.do_help.take_from_neare: Takes items from the nearest chest or barrel within 8 blocks.
rule.golemgarage.do_help.wait: Stands still. A rule higher up can still interrupt it.
rule.golemgarage.preset.follower.desc: Stays by your side and fights back for you.
rule.golemgarage.preset.guard.desc: Holds its post and attacks monsters that come near.
rule.golemgarage.preset.harvester.desc: Harvests and replants crops, then stores them.
rule.golemgarage.preset.hauler.desc: Moves everything from chest A to chest B.
rule.golemgarage.preset.medic.desc: Repairs itself and walks to the Garage when hurt.
rule.golemgarage.preset.night_guard.desc: Follows you by day, guards its post at night.
rule.golemgarage.ui.add_tip: Add a new rule at the bottom. You'll choose when it runs, then what it does.
rule.golemgarage.ui.add_unless_tip: Add an exception: the rule is skipped while this is true.
rule.golemgarage.ui.max: A golem can hold up to %s rules
rule.golemgarage.ui.no_rules: No rules: the golem just follows you. Pick a quick job or add a rule.
rule.golemgarage.ui.number_tip: Click to raise, right-click to lower, or scroll.
rule.golemgarage.ui.pick_do_new: New rule, step 2 of 2: what should it do?
rule.golemgarage.ui.pick_when_new: New rule, step 1 of 2: when should it run?
rule.golemgarage.ui.quick_jobs_hint: pick one, then tweak it below
rule.golemgarage.ui.rules_hint: checked top to bottom; the first one that's true runs
rule.golemgarage.ui.undo_tip: Put the rules back the way they were.
rule.golemgarage.when.away_from_post: it's over {} blocks from its post
rule.golemgarage.when_help.always: Always true. Put it last as the fallback job.
rule.golemgarage.when_help.away_from_pos: True when the golem has wandered this far from its post. Set a post with the Golem Linker.
rule.golemgarage.when_help.chest_a_below: True when linked chest A holds fewer than this many items.
rule.golemgarage.when_help.chest_a_has: True when linked chest A holds at least this many items.
rule.golemgarage.when_help.chest_b_full: True when linked chest B has no room left.
rule.golemgarage.when_help.crop_ready: True when a ripe crop is this close.
rule.golemgarage.when_help.health_below: True when the golem's health is under this percent.
rule.golemgarage.when_help.hostile_withi: True when a hostile mob is this close and the golem can see it.
rule.golemgarage.when_help.inventory_emp: True when the golem carries nothing.
rule.golemgarage.when_help.inventory_ful: True when the golem can't carry any more.
rule.golemgarage.when_help.none: The rule always runs when its "When" part is true.
rule.golemgarage.when_help.outside_area: True when the golem has left its work area. Mark two corners with the Golem Linker.
rule.golemgarage.when_help.owner_attacke: True for 10 seconds after something hurts you.
rule.golemgarage.when_help.owner_beyond: True when you are far from the golem.
rule.golemgarage.when_help.owner_within: True when you are close to the golem.
rule.golemgarage.when_help.part_broken: True when any part has worn out completely.
rule.golemgarage.when_help.part_worn: True when any part's durability is under this percent.
rule.golemgarage.when_help.power_below: True when the golem's power is under this percent. Great for "recharge".
rule.golemgarage.when_help.redstone_off: True when there's no redstone signal at the golem or its post.
rule.golemgarage.when_help.redstone_on: True when the golem or its post gets a redstone signal.
screen.golemgarage.golem.copy_group_tip: Save these rules and give a copy to every one of your golems in group %s (in this dimension).
screen.golemgarage.golem.mode_paused: Mode: %s is on, so these rules are paused. Switch to Rules on the Status tab to use them.
screen.golemgarage.golem.mode_tip: Click to switch: Rules, Aggressive, Peaceful, Guard. Any mode but Rules pauses the golem's rules.
screen.golemgarage.manual.no_recipe: Recipe not loaded.\nIt appears when a mod that provides this material is installed.

tooltip.golemgarage.bp_use: Use on a golem to rebuild it from your inventory
tooltip.golemgarage.broken: Broken: repair it in a Garage
tooltip.golemgarage.frame: Bare frame. Place it, then right-click it with parts.

tooltip.golemgarage.missing_mod: Material's mod is missing: works as iron
golemgarage.sign.title: GOLEM GARAGE
jei.golemgarage.info.garage_door: A roller door for your Garage. Place several side by side and stacked to make one big door; they open and close together. It rolls up by itself when a golem or cub comes near, with a redstone signal, or when you right-click it (right-click again to let it close). It counts as Garage wall, so the room stays complete with the door open.
jei.golemgarage.info.garage_window: Steel-framed glass for Garage walls and roofs, so you can watch the lasers at work. Any glass block or pane also works in a Garage wall or roof.
golemgarage.rig.cant_pack: Unload everyone first (only the owner can pack it up)
golemgarage.rig.no_room: Not enough room for the rig here
golemgarage.rig.tip: Use on the ground to drive. Sneak + right-click empty-handed to pack it up.
jei.golemgarage.info.rig: A drivable wasteland car. W and S drive, A and D steer, sneak gets out. Right-click it with coal or any furnace fuel to fill the tank (it crawls when empty). Iron, scrap and repair kits fix it, and parking it in a finished Garage patches it up. Fit a Spiked Ram (hits mobs hard at speed), Rig Plating (armour) and a Rig Turret (fires at hostile mobs while a golem rides along) by right-clicking it with them. Use a Golem Linker on it to load your nearby golems and cubs, or unload them. Sneak + right-click with an empty hand packs it back into an item.
jei.golemgarage.info.scrap: Salvage. Craft it from iron and gravel, find it in scrapyards, or take it from raiders. Builds and repairs rigs.
golemgarage.card.punched: Punched %s's rules onto the card (%s rules)
golemgarage.card.blank: Blank. Use it on your golem to copy its rules.
golemgarage.card.use: Use on a golem to load these rules. Craft with blank cards to copy.
jei.golemgarage.info.rule_card: Use a blank card on your golem to punch its rules onto it. Use a punched card on any of your golems to load those rules. Put a punched card in a crafting grid with blank cards to copy it (you keep the original). Sneak + use in the air wipes it. Cards turn up in scrapyards too.
golemgarage.raid.title: Raiders!
golemgarage.raid.subtitle: A convoy is coming from the %s
golemgarage.raid.subtitle_titan: A convoy and a Junk Titan are coming from the %s
golemgarage.raid.won: The raiders are beaten. Pick through what they left.
golemgarage.raid.no_room: Couldn't find anywhere for the raiders to come from
golemgarage.horn.no_target: Look at what you want them to charge
golemgarage.horn.tip: Use to command your golems within 48 blocks. Sneak + use to change the call.
jei.golemgarage.info.war_horn: Sound it to command all your golems within 48 blocks, overriding their rules and mode for a while. Rally: they run to you and fight anything that comes near (30 seconds). Hold: they stand where they are and fight anything within 8 blocks (1 minute). Charge: they all attack what you're looking at (20 seconds). Sneak + use to change the call.
golemgarage.spray.tip: Use on your golem for a custom finish. A water bucket washes it off.
golemgarage.tier.next.1: (5 x 5 inside and 3 emitters makes a Workshop)
golemgarage.tier.next.2: (7 x 7 inside and 4 emitters, 2 of them steel, makes an Industrial Bay)
golemgarage.fab.feed: Fabricating %s: feed it %s of one material
golemgarage.tablet.tip: Use to see all your golems: a map, recall, stop and resume, and a live camera.
golemgarage.tablet.too_far: That golem is too far away to watch
jei.golemgarage.info.fabricator: Builds golem parts with a robot arm. Sneak + right-click to choose the part, then feed it one material by hand, hopper or golem (6 to 9 of it, depending on the part; no extra ingredients needed). Take the part with a right-click, or a hopper underneath.
jei.golemgarage.info.golem_tablet: Shows all your golems on a radar map and in a list, with their health and what they're doing. Recall, stop or restart any of them, or watch through a nearby golem's eyes (sneak to stop).
jei.golemgarage.info.spray_can: Gives a golem a custom finish: flames, hazard stripes, rust, camo, chrome or tiger stripes. Each can does 16 golems. A water bucket washes it off.
jei.golemgarage.info.cub_bed: A little bed for cubs. At night, a cub within 16 blocks walks over, curls up and sleeps on it until morning.
golemgarage.configuration.title: Golem Garage Settings
golemgarage.cmd.trusted: %s can now use your golems and cubs.
golemgarage.cmd.untrusted: %s can no longer use your golems and cubs.
golemgarage.cmd.trusted_you: %s trusts you with their golems and cubs.
golemgarage.cmd.trust_none: You haven't trusted anyone yet. Use /gg trust <player>.
golemgarage.hint.first_part: Right-click a placed Golem Frame with a part to fit it. Give it a core too, so it has power.
golemgarage.hint.first_golem: Right-click your golem to open its panel and give it a job. A Golem Tablet keeps track of all your golems.
golemgarage.hint.breakdown: Your golem broke down. Bring it into a Garage to repair it; the manual's Garage chapter shows how to build one.
golemgarage.hint.first_cub: Cubs collect items around you. Right-click to dress them up, give them a cookie, or craft a Cub Bed for the night.
golemgarage.hint.raid: Raiders! Blow a War Horn to rally your golems, or Charge at the rig.
jei.golemgarage.info.garage_radio: A boombox for the garage. Right-click to switch it on or off, sneak + right-click to skip. It plays the music disc songs on shuffle, and cubs dance to it.
golemgarage.rig.about.interceptor: Fast and light. Hold jump for nitro.
golemgarage.rig.about.skimmer: Hovercraft: runs on land and water.
golemgarage.rig.has_cannon: The Juggernaut already has a cannon.
jei.golemgarage.info.solar_panel: Makes up to 40 FE/t under open sky, most at noon. Rain and storms cut it. Pipes and cables can pull from any side, and it pushes power into anything next to it.
jei.golemgarage.info.wind_turbine: Makes more the higher you build it: 6 FE/t near sea level, up to 70 FE/t high up, more in rain and storms. Keep the space around the rotor clear. Pipes and cables can pull from any side.
jei.golemgarage.info.burner_generator: Burns anything a furnace can (60 FE/t) or lava (120 FE/t). Pipes can feed it fuel and lava and take out empty buckets; energy comes out of every side.
jei.golemgarage.info.rig_interceptor: A fast, light rig. Hold jump while driving to charge the nitro, let go to fire it.
jei.golemgarage.info.rig_juggernaut: A slow tracked tank with thick armour and a heavy ram. Its cannon shells hostile mobs while anyone is aboard.
jei.golemgarage.info.rig_skimmer: A hovercraft with a big fan on the back. It drives over water as easily as over land.
golemgarage.planner.title: Garage Planner
golemgarage.planner.tier_hint.1: Repairs at normal speed. Go 5 x 5 for a Workshop.
golemgarage.planner.tier_hint.3: 4 emitters. With 2 steel ones it repairs half again as fast.
golemgarage.planner.show_tip: Shows the outline of this Garage in the world, even when you're not holding a controller. It hides by itself once the Garage is finished.
golemgarage.planner.build_tip: Builds the room from your inventory: walls from garage wall blocks (stone, bricks, planks, concrete...), floor and roof from any solid block, emitters steel first.
golemgarage.planner.ready: You have everything. Auto Build will use your blocks.
golemgarage.planner.missing: Not enough blocks yet. Red counts show what's short.
golemgarage.planner.blocked: %s blocks are in the way (red in the plan). Move them first.
golemgarage.planner.working: This Garage is finished and working. Break a wall to resize it.
golemgarage.planner.err.blocked: Something is in the way: clear the red blocks in the plan first.
golemgarage.planner.err.materials: You don't have enough blocks for this size.
golemgarage.planner.showcase_tip: Put golems here to show them off on trophy shelves inside the finished Garage. Bigger Garages hold more: 1 in the smallest, up to 6.
golemgarage.style.wasteland.about: Rusty corrugated iron and hazard stripes. No windows.
golemgarage.style.showroom.about: Clean painted steel with big windows on every wall and a glass roof, so you can see inside. Needs glass.
golemgarage.style.bunker.about: Blast concrete and dark steel with narrow slit windows under the roof.
golemgarage.style.barn.about: Red boards and white trim, with two windows down each side.
golemgarage.showcase.title: Garage Showcase
golemgarage.showcase.locked_tip: Build a bigger Garage to open this slot.
golemgarage.rig.parked: Parked: the golem driver stays here.
golemgarage.rig.following: The golem driver follows you again.
jei.golemgarage.info.battery: Stores 1,000,000 FE. It takes power on every side and sends it out of its front (the plug), at up to 4,000 FE/t. Keeps its charge when you break it. A comparator reads how full it is.
jei.golemgarage.info.cub_charger: Feed it power and Cubs within 5 blocks heal and get the treat bonus (2 more blocks of magnet reach), for 200 FE a second.
golemgarage.garage.power: Power: %s FE stored, repairs run at double speed.
rule.golemgarage.do_help.fish: Walks to water within sight and fishes, like a player with a rod.
rule.golemgarage.do_help.keep_bees: Collects from full beehives and bee nests: honey bottles if it carries glass bottles, honeycomb if it carries shears. Bees don't mind golems.
rule.golemgarage.do_help.smelt_at_furnac: Loads the nearest furnace, smoker or blast furnace with what it carries, feeds it fuel and takes out the results.
rule.golemgarage.do_help.trade: Walks to a villager and sells it what it carries for emeralds, as long as the villager wants it.
golemgarage.status.fail.needs_bottles: it needs glass bottles or shears to collect honey
golemgarage.status.no_buyer: No villager wants what it carries
golemgarage.status.fail.no_path: it can't find a way there
golemgarage.storm.start: A dust storm is coming! Get your golems under cover.
golemgarage.trip.no_crew: Load at least one golem first (use a Golem Linker on the rig).
golemgarage.trip.no_fuel: It needs at least an eighth of a tank for the trip.
golemgarage.trip.get_out: Get out first: the golems go on their own.
golemgarage.trip.left: The rig heads out scavenging. It'll be back in about %s minutes.
golemgarage.trip.back: Your scavenging crew is back at %s, %s, %s with a barrel of salvage!
golemgarage.arena.need_two: Two golems need to stand inside the ring.
golemgarage.arena.draw: The bout ends in a draw.
golemgarage.blueprint.empty: Sneak + use it on a Garage Controller to copy its plan first.
golemgarage.blueprint.need_controller: You need a Garage Controller to put down.
golemgarage.blueprint.placed: Controller placed with the plan. Get the blocks and use Auto Build.
golemgarage.blueprint.tip: Use on the ground to put down a controller with this plan and build it, or on a controller to apply it.
golemgarage.blueprint.tip_empty: Sneak + use on a Garage Controller to copy its size and style.
jei.golemgarage.info.arena_bell: Ring it with two golems standing inside its ring (6 blocks) and they spar. The first to drop to a quarter of its health yields. Nobody breaks down, and both earn experience: 40 for the winner, 15 for the loser.
jei.golemgarage.info.garage_blueprint: Copy a Garage's size and style with sneak + use on its controller, then use it on the ground to put down a controller with the same plan and build it from your inventory.
